candidates.hook: Alexander tenderly bandages Juliana's torn, bloody hands by the fire, raspy with grief: "You could have lost your hands."
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander vows that no one will ever hurt her again as his scarred knuckles clench into a fist of brewing vengeance beside a bucket of blood-soaked water.
candidates.why: Taps directly into the ultra-viral hurt/comfort and protective warrior revenge tropes that drive high conversion on TikTok and Reels.

candidates.hook: A blood-streaked, mud-caked hand uncurls amidst razor thorns revealing a signet ring as Juliana demands: "Now release my husband."
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander breaks free from iron shackles, rushes to Juliana, and gasps in heartbreak over her shredded hands: "What have they done to you?"
candidates.why: Opens with visceral visual trauma and immediate stakes, then cuts on an agonizing question before the emotional fallout is explained.

moments.desc: Juliana displays the retrieved signet ring with bloody hands and demands the constable release Alexander.
Alexander rushes to Juliana and weeps over her lacerated hands: "What have they done to you?"
Alexander vows no one will hurt her again as his fist clenches into an iron knot of vengeance over bloody water.
